MR Safety
MR Conditional (1.5T and 3T): at 1.5 T: Whole-Body SAR ≤ 2 W/kg, Maximum active scan time of 60 minutes, A cooling period of 15 minutes is required between scans; at 3 T: B1+rms ≤ 1.2 microtesla; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg, Limit total active scanning to 15 min.
Device configuration during MRI: Stimulation OFF.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
